function.description: Approve an EXACT token amount for a spender (e.g. a DEX router) before a swap. Unlimited approvals are refused. Revoke with revoke_approval when the trade is done. dry_run defaults to TRUE.
function.name: defi_trade_approve_token

amount.description: EXACT human amount to approve. Unlimited approvals are refused — approve only what this trade needs, then revoke.

chain.description: Chain to approve on — CHOOSE IT DELIBERATELY, because the same address is a different token on a different chain. Chains that can move value: ethereum, base, robinhood, arbitrum, polygon. Gas differs by orders of magnitude, so a cent-scale trade can cost more in gas on ethereum than it is worth, while base is a fraction of a cent. Per-chain guidance: the `chain` parameter of defi_trade.swap.

dry_run.description: TRUE simulates only. Set false to sign.

max_spend_usd.description: The most USD this approval may put at risk, asserted against the simulated allowance grant.

token.description: CONTRACT ADDRESS of the token to approve (0x…)

via.description: 'erc20' (default): token.approve(spender). 'permit2': an exact Permit2 grant, expiring in 15 min, to the pinned Uniswap v4 PositionManager only — the step before lp_add(protocol='v4').
